title: The hard summer
description: This modpack lets you experience a scorching summer in Minecraft
body:
🌡️ THE HARD SUMMER
Survive. Adapt. Endure.
A relentless summer has changed the world. Water is scarce, the sun is merciless, and every decision could mean your end. The Hard Summer transforms Minecraft into an intense survival experience where heat is your greatest enemy.

🔥 Features


Extreme Heat Systems
Overheat, find shade, or die. The temperature is your constant adversary.


Thirst & Dehydration
Water is essential for survival. Without planning, you’ll only last a few days.


Realistic Survival
Resources are scarce, and mistakes are punished.


New Crops & Food
Grow heat-resistant crops or find edible wild plants in a parched world.


Dynamic Environment
Hot days, arid biomes, and hostile conditions shape your gameplay.



🏜️ Gameplay Focus


Slow, strategic progression


Exploration instead of simple farm automation


Planning for water, food, and shelter


Survival under extreme conditions



⚠️ Difficulty
Very high
This modpack is intended for players seeking a real challenge. You will die. Often.

🧠 Tip
Move at night, avoid direct sunlight, and always plan your next water supply.

⚙️ Version


Minecraft: Fabric 1.21.1



If you’d like, I can also create:


a shorter version (for titles/previews)


or an English version for more downloads
